_comment: The Science Live nanopub TEMPLATES that ARE the schema for each FORRT chain step.
This file is the pin the audit found missing: without it, docs/forrt-form-fields.md
and the nanopubs/drafts/ skeletons are a hand transcription of a moving target, and
they drift (validation status 3-vs-5, confidence not captured, comment cap 500-vs-800).
`superseded` URIs are vendored from that file's LEGACY_TEMPLATE_URIS. Those are prior
template versions that have real published nanopubs on the network and must still be
recognised. They are NOT the full npx:supersedes chain: most templates supersede several
throwaway test iterations (AIDA's chain is 11 deep) that were never published from and are
deliberately excluded. Criterion for inclusion: a prior version with >=1 published nanopub.
fields.snapshot.json pins the extracted field spec of each `current` template.
scripts/check_template_drift.py compares the live templates against that snapshot;
re-vendor (script --update) when a template is superseded upstream. See README.md.
